blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Land Transportation Office in Central Visayas (LTO-7) suspended the driver’s license and issued a show cause order against the motorist who tested positive for alcohol after a Sept. 21 crash that killed a pedestrian and injured another in Cebu City.
